name: Aditya Birla Real Estate Ltd
summary: Aditya Birla Real Estate Limited develops and leases property, mainly in India, and reports in Real Estate and Other segments. It builds commercial and residential projects and also has viscose filament, tyre yarn, salt works and chemicals activities. Formerly Century Textiles and Industries Limited, it took its current name in September 2024; it was incorporated in 1897 and is based in Mumbai.
